Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice D K Singh
 and
 Hon'Ble Ms. Justice Tara Vitasta Ganju
 Oral Judgment

(PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE D K SINGH)
1.

The present appeal has been instituted by the claimants impugning the judgment and awarded dated 10.01.2022 passed by the Court of XIV Additional Small Causes Judge and Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Bengaluru in MVC No.795/2019.
2.

entities.text: Additional Small Causes Judge and Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Bengaluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The factum regarding the accident and death of Sri.Basavaraj C.N, son of Nagappa.B in a motor vehicle accident on 23.12.2018 is not in dispute.
The liability of the insurance company is also not in dispute.
The only dispute is in respect of the quantum of compensation as assessed by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988.
3. The Tribunal while calculating the loss of dependency has taken the income of the deceased at 9,000/-.

As the accident had taken place in the year 2018, as per the NC: 2025:KHC:50576-DB HC-KAR Circular issued by the Karnataka Legal Service Authority, the notional income of the deceased should have been taken as 12,500/- per month.
There are five dependants of the deceased.
Therefore, 1/4th income of the deceased has to be deducted for his own expenses.

Thus,
loss of dependency is re-assessed as 12,500/- + 5000/- (50% future prospects) which comes to 17,500/- x 12 x 14 (as the deceased was 37 years of age) x 3/4 =22,05,000/-.
In respect of the conventional heads, there are five dependants.
Therefore, the loss of consortium should be 40,000 x 5 = 2,00,000/-; 15,000/- is granted for loss of estate; and 15,000/- for funeral expenses.

Thus,
the total compensation is assessed at 24,35,000/-.
4. The compensation has been assessed at 18,71,000/- by the Trial Court.
Thus, the appellants are entitled for the enhanced compensation of 5,64,000/-.

The appellants are entitled for the enhanced compensation so assessed with interest at the rate of 6% per annum NC:
2025:KHC:50576-DB HC-KAR from the date of presenting the claim petition, till the date of realisation.
5. Accordingly, the appeal is allowed.

Sd/-
(D K SINGH) JUDGE Sd/-
(TARA VITASTA GANJU) JUDGE GH List No.: 1 Sl No.: 14 Chandramma.
